title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
input_format:
Line 1: Integer n.
Line 2: n space-separated heights.
output_format: Print the total trapped water units.

sample_tests.explanation: Traps 6 units of rain water between peaks.
Traps 2 units in the middle dip.
Traps 11 total water units between borders.
